name: context-meter
description: Live context meter for the planner session: context size, colour-stepped bar, session token totals, and compact / clear / hand-off actions (AISDLC-743)

amberAtPercent.title: Amber at (% of window)
amberAtPercent.description: Bar turns amber at or above this share of the context window.

hotAtPercent.title: Wrap-up warning at (% of window)
hotAtPercent.description: The band tells you to hand off soon at or above this share.

redAtPercent.title: Red / clearing level (% of window)
redAtPercent.description: Bar turns red at or above this share; 15% of a 1M window is the 150k ceiling.
